faqs.a:
(a)
In a block which has been designated as a restricted parking area adjacent to an affected
               public school and in which there have been erected signs that conform to the requirements
               of law, on-street parking of motor vehicles may be prohibited between the hours of
               9:00 a.m. and 8:30 p.m., holidays excepted, or as denoted on signs posted in the area,
               unless there is properly displayed in the vehicle the permit provided for in
section 54-246
. For purposes of this article, such a permit is properly displayed only when it is
               located on the dashboard of the vehicle in front of the driver's seat and the date
               of expiration of the permit is clearly visible through the windshield of the vehicle.
(b)
In a block which has been designated as a restricted parking area adjacent to an affected
               public park and in which there have been erected signs that conform to the requirements
               of law, on-street parking of motor vehicles shall be prohibited on the side of the
               street immediately adjacent to residences unless there is properly displayed in the
               vehicle the parking permit provided for in
section 54-246
. For purposes of this article, such a permit is properly displayed only when it is
               located on the dashboard of the vehicle in front of the driver's seat and the date
               of expiration of the permit is clearly visible through the windshield of the vehicle.
(c)
The owner, driver, or both, of any vehicle that is parked in violation of this article
               shall be subject to the penalty provided for in
section 54-249
.
(Code 1981, § 17-127; Ord. No. 2804, § 1, 4-15-1991; Ord. No. 2996, § 1, 8-16-1993;
               Ord. No. 3380, § 1, 6-30-1997;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
